steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&1.2756\times 10^{4}\\[5pt]&\text{Power is POSITIVE }(4)\to \text{ move the}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{decimal point }4\text{ places to the RIGHT}\\[5pt]&1.2756\times 10^{4}=12,756\\[5pt]&\text{Diameter of Earth }\approx 12,756km\end{aligned}\]
